name: Art brut
description: Raw, untrained-looking art: thick black outlines enclosing cell-like shapes, crowded figures and faces, graffiti marks and naive patterns that fill the whole surface.
light: no light source, flat colour on paper or canvas
composition: all-over and crowded, interlocking cells and figures to the edges, or one big naive figure on plain paper
camera_or_medium: marker, gouache and oil stick on paper or raw canvas; childlike, confident lines
texture_detail: wobbly hand-drawn outlines, hatching in red and blue, visible brush and crayon, paper grain
subjects: a city made of interlocking cells
a crowd of grinning naive figures
a cat built from patterned shapes
a portrait covered in scribbled marks
